Lighthouse Hotel
Private. Unexpected. Unmistakably Key West.
Just steps from the iconic Key West Lighthouse and the Ernest Hemingway Home & Museum, Lighthouse Hotel pairs historic character with thoughtful design and warm, personalized hospitality. Thoughtful gathering spaces, genuine service, and meaningful details create a stay that feels welcoming, effortless, and entirely your own.
Explore Rooms & Suites
Isabel's Bar
Plan Your Event
View Gallery
Hemingway, Isabel & a Legacy of Welcome
Beautifully restored mid-1800s buildings reflect the rich history woven throughout Lighthouse Hotel. The property s connection to Ernest Hemingway and Isabel, his trusted seamstress and longtime companion, lives on through Isabel s Restaurant & Bar, while its legacy as one of Key West s pioneering LGBTQ+ welcoming hotels remains an important part of its identity. Today, the hotel s storied past is complemented by thoughtful touches that honor its heritage while embracing the spirit of modern island hospitality.
A Beacon of Island Hospitality
Discover poolside dining, live music, concierge services, island transportation, and thoughtful amenities designed to make every moment memorable.
Stay Inspired, The  lighthouse INnkeepers
Poolside at Lighthouse
Settle into a sun lounger, take a refreshing swim, or relax at a shaded table as the day unfolds. The pool is at the heart of Lighthouse Hotel, offering a welcoming place to slow down, reconnect, and enjoy the simple pleasure of an afternoon spent in the sunshine.
Breakfast, Island Style
Complimentary continental breakfast is served poolside each morning from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Guests may also enjoy a selection of chef-prepared à la carte breakfast specialties available for purchase.
View à la carte breakfast menu.
Live Music
Discover the sounds of Key West at Lighthouse Hotel, where live local music creates the perfect backdrop for an afternoon or evening in Old Town. Settle in with a handcrafted cocktail or light bite at Isabel s Lighthouse and enjoy performances from some of the island s favorite musicians on select days throughout the week.
Welcome Cocktails
Upon arrival, you ll receive two Isabel s Thimbles, redeemable for a welcome cocktail at our poolside bar. Simply present your thimble at Isabel s and enjoy a signature mojito or your favorite cocktail while relaxing by the pool in the heart of Old Town. It s the perfect way to begin your stay.
Amenities at Lighthouse
Enjoy thoughtful amenities designed to make your stay at Lighthouse Hotel Key West effortless, including complimentary Wi-Fi, continental breakfast, filtered water stations, daily coffee and tea service, yoga mats, live music, daily happy hour, and two welcome cocktails.
On-Site Rentals
Explore more with convenient on-site rentals, including cruiser bikes, e-bikes, scooters, and golf carts through our partner, Island Safari Rentals. Scan the QR code located on the bike signage around the property or visit the front desk, and our team will be happy to assist with your reservation.
Concierge Services
Need local recommendations? Our concierge, Jenny Berube, can help arrange dining reservations, island adventures, and personalized Key West itineraries.

Eat + drink
Isabel s
Restaurant and Bar
Steps from the legendary Hemingway Home & Museum, Isabel s is Lighthouse Hotel s inviting poolside bar and a favorite place to gather throughout the day. Start your morning with a specialty coffee and complimentary breakfast, then return for a relaxed lunch, handcrafted cocktails, and island-inspired favorites in a tropical setting.
No visit is complete without a classic mojito, famously one of Ernest Hemingway s favorite cocktails during his years in Key West. Just moments from the home where he lived and wrote many of his most celebrated works, Isabel s offers the perfect place to raise a glass and experience a piece of the island s literary history while soaking up the laid-back atmosphere of Old Town.

Fitch Lodge
Charming. Walkable. Adventurous.
For travelers who believe the journey is just as memorable as the destination, Fitch Lodge is the perfect place to begin. Within walking distance of the Historic Seaport, waterfront restaurants, and unforgettable island adventures, every day starts with something new to discover. Genuine hospitality, comfortable accommodations, and an easygoing atmosphere make it easy to head out, explore more, and return to a place that already feels familiar.
Explore Fitch Lodge Rooms
Plan Your Event
View Gallery
A Legacy by the Seaport
Rich in Conch character, Fitch Lodge reflects the easygoing spirit of one of Key West s oldest neighborhoods. Once home to seafarers, fishermen, and island residents, the surrounding streets continue to tell the story of the island s maritime heritage. Today, that same sense of discovery lives on, making Fitch Lodge the ideal home base for days spent on the water, wandering hidden lanes, discovering local favorites, and experiencing Key West beyond the guidebooks.
Adventure Starts Here
Thoughtfully curated local recommendations, exclusive savings on island transportation, comfortable outdoor spaces, and easy access to the Historic Seaport make Fitch Lodge the perfect home base for every Key West adventure.
stay inspired, fitch lodge innkeepers
Recharge Poolside
After a day on the water or exploring the island, the pool at Fitch Lodge is the perfect place to recharge. Take a refreshing swim, relax on a shaded lounger, or simply unwind before heading back out for your next adventure. It s a comfortable place to pause, reset, and plan where the day takes you next.
Afternoon Refresher
Stop by the lobby each afternoon from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM for a complimentary ice-cold lemonade. Bright, refreshing, and perfect after a day of exploring, it s a simple way to cool off before your next adventure. Prefer something a little stronger? Ask for a splash of Key West Wreckers Vodka from Key West Trading Co. and enjoy a local twist on this afternoon favorite.
Dive into Adventure
Discover the island from the water with exclusive guest savings on snorkel and scuba diving trips through Southpoint Divers . From vibrant coral reefs to unforgettable underwater experiences, plus discounted gear rentals, it s an easy way to make the most of your time on the island.
Amenities at Fitch Lodge
Personalized concierge services, in-room Wi-Fi, yoga mats, and coffee and tea service, along with a daily boozy lemonade at 3pm and local partner perks with some of our favorite neighborhood spots, including Old Town Bakery and Southpoint Divers.
Breakfast Around The Corner
Start your morning with a favorite from Old Town Bakery , located just a short walk from Fitch Lodge. As our guest, you ll receive an exclusive discount to enjoy freshly baked pastries, breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and other local favorites before setting out for the day.
Explore Beyond The Lodge
Explore more of Key West with Island Safari Rentals, offering convenient bike, e-bike, scooter, and golf cart rentals for Fitch Lodge guests. Scan the QR code on the bike signage throughout the property or stop by the front desk to reserve your rental and start exploring the island at your own pace.
Concierge Services
Need local recommendations? Our concierge, Jenny Berube, can help arrange dining reservations, island adventures, and personalized Key West itineraries.

The History of Key West Historic Inns Collection | Our Story
Our Storied History

Reserve Today
In Key West, tales of the past linger around every corner, but nowhere more vividly than within our collection of historic inns. Each colorful property weaves a narrative scented with the rich aroma of Cuban cigars, sea air, and spirited libations. Join us on a captivating journey through Key West history as we unlock the stories hidden within our charming inns.
Ridley House
A Naturalist’s Legacy in Old Town
At the heart of Ridley House lies a rich history that will transport you to the romance of the late 1800s. Originally the estate of prosperous industrialist Richard Kemp, this picturesque poolside haven features colonial wood-frame houses adorned with Carpenter Victorian and Bahamian Eyebrow styles. As you explore the main building, you’ll uncover a rare glimpse of upper-class 19th-century Floridian interiors. Kemp was a passionate fisherman and naturalist, and Ridley House takes its name from his discovery of Kemp’s Ridley sea turtle, adding a fascinating layer to the estate’s historical tapestry.
Explore Ridley House
Winslow’s Bungalows
Art & Architectural History
Nestled on these historic grounds are Key West’s first motel and some of its oldest homes. Owned by a diverse array of figures — from Colonel Walter Maloney to an Irish steamboat captain, a circus performer, and a cigar maker — the property has witnessed several transformations, including as a vaudeville venue and fruit grove. It was named for Winslow Homer, the renowned American painter who found creative solace in Key West in the early 20th century. Today, within a lushly landscaped campus boasting three shimmering pools, you’ll discover vibrant interiors preserving Queen Anne, Carpenter Victorian and classic Conch styles.
Explore Winslow's Bungalows
Ella’s Cottages
A romance for the ages
The Alburys, Key West’s premier landowners, began developing Old Town’s Simonton Street in the 1800s. In the early years, the buildings constructed by the Alburys provided homes to Cuban cigar makers. Later they were rented to Navy personnel in the years leading up to World War II. As time went on, some of the structures assumed roles as a tailor shop, butcher shop, gambling house, hotel and beauty salon. At one point, the property was owned by a steamboat captain named Peter Hanlon, who later passed the property on to his widow, Ella, whose name still graces this elegant escape.
Explore Ella’s Cottages
Lighthouse Hotel
Golden Mysteries & Inclusive Stays
Located within view of iconic Key West landmarks, Lighthouse Hotel is a group of structures originally built in the mid-1800s. The oldest and most prominent was occupied by U.S. Army Surgeon Dr. Daniel Whitehurst. In the 1980s, the Lighthouse Hotel underwent a transformation, becoming one of Key West’s pioneering LGBTQ guesthouses. This era also brought an intriguing discovery to light: over two pounds of solid gold nuggets and coins from South America were found at the bottom of an old well. The mystery surrounding the golden treasure remains unsolved, adding an enigmatic layer to the history of this quintessential Key West retreat.
Explore Lighthouse Hotel
Fitch Lodge
Seafaring & Free-Spirited
Named in honor of an early owner, this collection of turn-of-the-20th-century Conch houses has long opened its doors to free-spirited travelers, seafarers and adventurers. Henry “Harry” Fitch was a classic Key West figure who led an eclectic life, with roles ranging from U.S. Coast Guard seaman to carpenter to postmaster. Over the years, the properties have been home to dock workers, fishermen, sailors, and even a cycle shop. Listed among the National Registry of Historic Places, the timeless Carpenter Victorian exteriors remain virtually unchanged.
Explore Fitch Lodge

Key West Historic Hotel FAQs | Key West Historic Inns Collection
Frequently Asked Questions
We’re here to help you create your ideal Key West getaway. Explore this page for answers to frequently asked questions. Want more information about our inns? Email us and a member of our team will reach out.

Is it better to stay in Old Town Key West?
Old Town Key West is the most popular area to stay, offering historic architecture, walkable streets, vibrant restaurants, and easy access to beaches, attractions, and nightlife. Stay with us in the heart and home of the action.
When is the best time to visit Key West?
Key West offers year-round festivals, live music, stunning sunsets and island events , making it a vibrant destination in every season—from winter sunshine to spring festivals and summer nights celebrations.
Is Old Town Key West walkable?
Yes. Old Town Key West is one of the most walkable neighborhoods in Florida , making it easy to explore restaurants, beaches, shops, and historic sites from our inns generally within a 10-15 minute stroll.
Is the pool bar open to the public?
Yes. We are open and would love to welcome registered hotel guests and locals alike.
What kind of atmosphere can guests expect?
Expect an easygoing island escape—tropical gardens, refreshing drinks, and a breezy poolside setting where guests can unwind, socialize, and enjoy the timeless charm of Key West.
Which Inns have a Restaurant and Bar?
Guests of the Key West Historic Inns have access to two exclusive bar experiences. Both bars are exclusive to overnight guests of our five inns, creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere just for those staying with us.
Guests can relax in a lush tropical setting while enjoying poolside bites, handcrafted cocktails, sparkling bubbles, and ice-cold beer. Our poolside bar blends contemporary mixology with the laid-back charm of Key West, making it easy to sip, snack, and unwind as the island breeze drifts through the gardens.
Bungalow Bar
Located  at Winslow’s Bungalows,  this open-air cocktail bar offers laid-back island vibes and refreshing drinks enjoyed under swaying palms.
Isabel’s
Our island-chic poolside bar  at Lighthouse Hotel,  perfect for cocktails by the water from day to night.
Does Key West Historic Inns offer bike rentals?
Yes! We’re excited to partner with Island Safari Rentals to offer cruiser bikes, e-bikes, scooters, and golf carts for our guests.
What kinds of bikes are available?
Guests can rent:
Classic cruiser bikes (Jamis or Sun Cruisers)
E-bikes
Scooters
Golf carts
When will the new bikes arrive?
Our custom Key West Historic Inns cruiser bikes will be arriving in the coming weeks. Until then, bikes are still available to rent immediately and will be delivered to your property as needed.
How many bikes are available at each hotel?
Each property will have its own set of cruiser bikes onsite:
Lighthouse Hotel – 6 bikes
Ella’s Cottages – 4 bikes
Fitch Lodge – 6 bikes
Winslow’s Bungalows – 8 bikes
Ridley House – 4 bikes
If bikes are fully rented out, additional bikes can be brought over quickly.
What comes with my bike rental?
Every rental includes:
Helmet
Bike lights
Basket
Lock and key
Custom Key West Historic Inns bike plate
How do I reserve a bike?
It’s easy!
Scan the QR code located on bike signage around the property, or
Visit the front desk , and the team can assist with your reservation.
How long does delivery take?
Most rentals are delivered to your hotel within 15–30 minutes once reserved.
What is the check-in age at each hotel?
Guests must be 21 years of age or older to check in at all Key West Historic Inns properties, with the exception of Fitch Lodge , where the minimum check-in age is 18 .
A valid government-issued ID and a credit or debit card are required at check-in.
I need to make a change to my reservation, who can I contact?
To change or modify an existing reservation , please reach out directly to the property where your stay is booked. Our reservation teams are happy to assist with date changes, room updates, cancellations, or special requests .

Do you offer ADA accessible accommodations?
We offer ADA accessible guest rooms designed to ensure comfort, safety, and ease of access for guests with disabilities. Many of our shared spaces are also accessible , including select entrances, pathways, and common areas. If you have specific accessibility needs, we’re happy to help recommend the best room type and location for your stay.
Visit Accessibility for more information about our accessible features and amenities.
Is parking available at the inns?
Parking availability varies by property. Some of our inns offer limited on-site parking for a nightly fee , while others provide easy access to street parking and nearby city lots . Because Key West is a historic, walkable area, parking can be limited, so we recommend checking availability upon arrival.
Winslow’s Bungalows
Limited on-site parking is available for $30 per night . Parking requests can be made at check-in .
Ella’s Cottages
Limited on-site parking is available for $30 per night . The parking lot is located adjacent to the property via Petronia Street.
Directions to the lot:
Traveling north via Simonton: Right on Olivia → Left on Elizabeth → Left on Petronia (lot mid-block on left)
Traveling south via Simonton: Left on Angela → Right on Elizabeth → Right on Petronia (lot mid-block on right)
Lighthouse Hotel
Limited on-site parking is available for $30 per night. Parking requests can be made at check-in and are granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
Ridley House
There is no on-site parking . Street parking and public city lots are available nearby.
